        ParserNG is the height of interpreted Math parsing in Java. It is the fastest of all interpreted Java math parsers.

items.title:
com.github.gbenroscience:parser-ng-gpu-simd 3.0.2 发布, Hardware-accelerated, scalable(scalability of SIMD tested on Linux-(Centos tested)) SIMD vector and GPU calculation pipelines for ParserNG.
        Fastest Java math evaluator in the world period
        Rich and Performant, Cross Platform Java Library(100% Java).No native dependencies.(e.g. JNI) 
        Version 3.0.2 features GPU bulk evaluation for OpenCL(tested) and CUDA. It also features the SIMDEnginvEvaluator and SIMDCommandTurboEvaluator, both
        of which benefit from CPU Pinning to minimize cache thrashing and other stories. This leads to highly efficient worker-count to output velocity conversion. 
        For library support, customizations or donations, reach me at gbenroscience@gmail.com|+2348165779034

	  Spring Boot 4 / the cadenzaflow starter-4 family. Identical sources to
	  the primary artifact, recompiled against spring-web 7: Spring 7 changed
	  binary signatures the 6-compiled jar depends on (HttpHeaders no longer
	  implements MultiValueMap, so e.g. the HttpEntity constructors take
	  HttpHeaders now), which makes the primary jar fail with
	  IncompatibleClassChangeError on a Spring 7 classpath.
